mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-4167a81c.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    baseline = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if baseline is None:
        return out
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[baseline]):
        if value not in (2, 8):
            continue
        rise = 4 if value == 2 else 3
        top = max(0, baseline - rise)
        for r in range(top + 1, baseline):
            out[r][c] = 1
        out[top][c] = value
    return out
PY
